title: GTA 6 vs GTA 5: The Biggest Differences Explained
desc: GTA 6 vs GTA 5: a new state, two leads instead of three, a map about twice as big, a higher price, and no GTA Online or PC version at launch. No spoilers.
lede: Thirteen years separate GTA 5 (2013) and GTA 6 (November 19, 2026). Here are the differences that matter before you play, with no story spoilers.
sections: GTA 5 is set in San Andreas, around Los Santos. GTA 6 moves to Leonida, Rockstar's version of Florida, with a modern Vice City at its center. The six places.
GTA 5 switched between Michael, Franklin and Trevor. GTA 6 has two: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
Rockstar has said Leonida is about twice the size of GTA 5's map. Map size explained.
GTA 5 launched at $59.99. GTA 6 is $79.99 (standard) and $99.99 (Ultimate) in the US, and the install is up to 212 GB. Make room.
GTA 5 had GTA Online two weeks after launch. GTA 6's new online mode is expected in 2027. Both games skipped PC at launch; GTA 6 on PC is reportedly early 2027.
GTA 6 is current-gen only: PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No PS4 or Xbox One version.
